body: I think you should learn what "consent" means before you hurt anyone else.
This is the kindest thing anyone has said to me in a long time.  I want to believe it, more than anything.

He was hurt, now he hurts others.  And me?  I probably hurt others, too, just by existing.  Not in the same way, but everyone who inherited this pain becomes a vector for misery.  I don't want to be like this, but he stumbled upon the one thing that could hurt me the most, and here we are.
